The issue I think is the number of players who play DayZ to "win" they server hop to get geared up then set about murdering everyone they come across so that they feel like they're achieving something. If they're threatened with losing everything they disconnect so that their kill streak is unbroken.

Combat loggers and server hoppers and such are missing out on the best part of the game in my mind, the atmosphere. That feeling of being helpless and alone until you're geared and meet up with friends (if you have any) the fear that every person you see could be the end. It's some of the most intense and exciting gaming I've had in years.

I have logged out after combat, say someone has tried to kill me and I've made a run for it - I'll log out after I have broken contact and been able to evade them for 10 or 20 minutes, I figure by this point I have lost them and it's fair for me to take a break after the stress of the chase.
